This is a private launcher: it opens the apps you pick from a list behind your PIN. Android does not let an ordinary app remove another app\'s icon from your home screen or app drawer, so removing an app here only takes it off this list — it still appears everywhere else on the phone. To actually hide icons you would have to make this app the default launcher, or use a managed device profile. Nothing is uploaded: the app list is read locally and only your chosen package names are stored, encrypted on this device.
